questions.q: What does the building in the video look like?
questions.e: In the video: "Beograd ima zgradu koja izgleda kao ogromna Toblerone čokolada" — Belgrade has a building that looks like a huge Toblerone chocolate bar.

questions.q: In which district does it stand?
questions.e: In the video: "Ova neobična zgrada nalazi se na Karaburmi" — this unusual building is located in Karaburma.
In the video: "Izgrađena je početkom šezdesetih godina" — it was built in the early sixties.

questions.q: Why was the building nicknamed Toblerone?
o: Because of its stepped shape with balconies and terraces
questions.e: In the video: "Zbog tog karakterističnog oblika Beograđani su je vremenom prozvali Toblerone" — because of that characteristic shape, Belgraders eventually nicknamed it Toblerone.

questions.q: Is that the official name of the building?
questions.e: In the video: "taj nadimak nije njen zvanični naziv" — that nickname is not its official name.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Stepenasto — in a stepped way; stepenik — a step.
Prozvati — to name, to give a nickname.
Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na Karaburmi.
Genitive plural: šezdesetih godina — "of the sixties".
Sa requires the instrumental case: sa balkonima i terasama.
The subject is Beograđani, plural: prozvali.
